mapper.select: SELECT * FROM note WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId} AND id=#{noteId}
SELECT * FROM note WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId} AND content_sha256=#{hash}
SELECT count(*) FROM note WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId}
SELECT id FROM note WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId} AND id IN #{id}
SELECT id,owner_id,title,original_filename,byte_size,status,chunk_count,created_at FROM note WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM note WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId} AND id=#{noteId}
